# Nye's script 

To test whether mitox participants who developed an irAE were more likely to respond to tx.

```{r}
df <- readxl::read_xlsx("../data/filename")
```

The bottom script assumes that `df` has (at least these) 4 columns: ID, cohort, recist, and irAE.

First, filter to the metastatic cohort. 

```{r}
x <- 
  df %>%
  filter(cohort == "metastatic")
```



```{r}
table <- table(x$recist, x$irAE)
table
```


```{r}
fisher.test(table)
```
